name: Wordmark under strain
look: A closing word compresses and settles above its action. The complete word and working button stand from the first frame.
reduced: The finished composition: the markup as the page writes it, nothing moving.
phone: The word fits the phone width, the action stays underneath and the meta row wraps.
place: At the end of the page, as the call to action; the footer after it keeps the same ground. Once per page. For a loud brand only (a band, a race or a sports brand, a studio that shouts): never deal it to a calm house, a guesthouse, a craft or a care practice, where the strain reads as a broken word. At rest the word reads whole.
content: One closing word of four to eight letters, a two- or three-word action, a short offer and real contact details. Use a heavy display face with at least 7:1 ink contrast.
options: Hold 1, phoneHold 1. Echo is off by default. Squash up to 0.15. The closing button stays in place.
